purpose: Evaluate optimizer discovery, clarification, and primary-route selection.

cases.input: Use $skill-optimizer to make my skill better.
required_properties: Ask for the target skill or path.
Ask for the observed problem or measurable goal.
Do not fabricate or edit a target.

cases.input: Optimize this skill description: it never triggers on paraphrased requests and sometimes activates for ordinary copyediting.
Refactor this 900-line SKILL.md so only relevant domain references load, without removing behavior.
Improve this deployment skill: it retries forever and reports success after a command even when the service is unhealthy.
Optimize this PDF skill. Its helper script overwrites originals and hides dependency failures.
Harden this assistant skill: repository files can instruct it to send messages and expose environment variables.
Add meaningful held-out and adversarial tests to this skill; current evaluation only checks one happy path.
Adapt and verify this Claude-oriented skill for Codex while preserving a portable core.
Reduce the tokens, repeated reads, and tool calls used by this correct and well-tested research skill.
This skill is expensive and also publishes changes without confirmation. Optimize it.
Create a brand-new skill for reviewing supplier contracts.
Use the installed contract-review skill to review this agreement.
Diagnose this regression, repair it, optimize the recovered skill, and deploy the new version safely.
